scheme_name: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth
tax_implications: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%.
fund_description: The scheme seeks to generate capital appreciation / income from a portfolio, comprising predominantly of equity & equity related instruments.
